capabilities: animate code blocks in Reading Mode
wrap multiple code blocks with ~~~magic-move fences
apply syntax highlighting to animated code
configure duration, stagger, and line numbers animation
extras: README has typos and a short TODO section (line highlighting mix, living preview); usage is only in Reading Mode unless the markdown variant is used.
problem: Obsidian renders code blocks as static text, so there is no built-in way to animate how code evolves step by step.
summary: Plugin that animates code blocks, stepping through versions of the code with syntax highlighting and selectable themes.
